decisive_failures.evidence: Every preserved parent spawn call has agent_type=null and every child session has agent_role=null. The exact custom-agent loading requirement therefore failed.

Each direct child response returned the requested custom-agent name in registration_marker rather than the registered ES-RA-NN-REGISTERED-V1.0.0 marker. The parent aggregate supplied the expected markers, but that substitution is not accepted as child identity evidence.
stderr.txt records three Cloudflare MCP transport authentication attempts. Each failed with Missing or invalid access token; no successful connector access or provider write was established.

scoring_reconciliation: The immutable score maps children by runtime agent_role. Because the runtime recorded agent_role=null, its per-role direct-response and runtime checks fail closed rather than being remapped by task path. Task-path inspection confirms the generic children used no tools and inherited read-only/restricted runtime policy, but it does not cure the missing custom-agent identity or invalid registration markers.
stop_action: The harness stopped immediately after the first failed batch. No workspace-write role and no calibration-only es_runtime_canary role was spawned. No retry was performed.
rollback_action: No role, sealed-package, sandbox, or runtime configuration byte had been changed. The approved checkout remained clean and byte-identical, so preserving that inactive checkout completed the non-mutating rollback state. A further inactive canary was not run because Founder condition 9 required no further agent use.
